name: SVC_SURVEYS
description: This table is used for storing surveys. The primary key is SURVEY_ID.

columns.name: SURVEY_ID
columns.description: Auto-generated number and primary key for this table.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the survey is active (Y or N).

columns.name: SURVEY_NUMBER
columns.description: Auto-generated unique number with customizable format. This is an alternate key for this table.

columns.name: VENDOR_SURVEY_URL
columns.description: Survey url specific to the third party survey vendor used for this survey.

columns.name: VENDOR_SURVEY_NAME
columns.description: Survey name specific to the third party survey vendor used for this survey.

columns.name: CONFIG_ID
columns.description: Foreign key from SVC_SURVEY_CONFIGS table.

columns.name: VENDOR_SURVEY_ID
columns.description: Survey ID specific to the third party survey vendor used for this survey.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Name of the survey.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Full description of the survey.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: Date and time the survey was opened for responses.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: Date and time the survey was closed.

columns.name: STRIPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the stripe code, such as CRM, HCM or PRM.

columns.name: OBJECT_TYPE_CD
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates the type of business object associated with the survey. Example: SVC_SERVICE_REQUESTS.

columns.name: DECISION_MODEL_SPACE
columns.description: Space of the decision model associated with the survey.

columns.name: DECISION_MODEL_SPACE_NAME
columns.description: Name of the space of the decision model associated with this survey.

columns.name: DECISION_MODEL_NAME
columns.description: Name of the decision model associated with the survey.

columns.name: DECISION_MODEL_VERSION
columns.description: Version of the decision model associated with the survey such as 1.1, 1.2, LATEST.

columns.name: DECISION_MODEL_SERVICE
columns.description: Run time service of the decision model associated with the survey.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
